Milk + Honey Spa’s Fall Specials Are All About Getting Grounded

Posted in Lifestyle By Dani Dudek
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:27
Instaread

Fall is the perfect excuse to slow down, reset and give yourself a little extra TLC. And milk + honey Spa is making that easier with seasonal treatments designed to help you leave summer behind and settle into the season ahead.

The Austin-founded spa’s fall specials feature its signature No. 46 grounding scent, a warm, earthy blend of sandalwood, vetiver and cardamom that brings a little extra sensory indulgence to the experience. The best part? You get to take a piece of that relaxation home with you.

Here’s Everything Milk + Honey Is Offering This Fall

The Fall Reset Facial is a 75-minute treatment that includes a warming apple spice enzyme mask, PCA Skin’s Oxygenating Trio and gua sha to help refresh and brighten the skin. The spa’s signature No. 46 aromatherapy is woven throughout the service, and guests receive a complimentary No. 46 Grounding Essential Oil to continue the ritual at home. The facial starts at $230.

Prefer to focus on relaxing your body? The Fall Grounding Massage combines a 75-minute restorative massage with seasonal back and foot scrubs to smooth the skin and ease everyday tension. The No. 46 scent is incorporated throughout the treatment, and guests also receive the essential oil to take home. The massage starts at $215.

And let’s not forget about the face! Their Seasonal PCA Peel + Facial is a limited-time seasonal treatment that combines their customized Express Facial with a PCA Skin peel enhancement for brighter, smoother skin, plus the essential post-peel take-home kit to extend your results at home. The price for this starts at $175.

It’s the thoughtful touch that makes these seasonal specials feel like more than just a spa appointment. Whether you’re looking to refresh your skin or simply carve out some time to unwind, milk + honey is giving you a way to bring that feeling of calm into your everyday routine.

These fall spa offers are available through November 22, 2026, at participating milk + honey locations.

Ready to book? Visit milk + honey Spa to explore the seasonal services and make your reservation.

And while you’re there, grab a gift card! It’s the perfect thing to share with family and friends this holiday season.
